name: Perez
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: She bore twins; Zarah put out his hand first and got the scarlet thread, then drew it back and Pharez broke forth, so Pharez means a breach and the line of the kings runs through him.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Do not hear Pharez and think the Pharisees came from the Pharzites; the Pharisees did not come out of that family. The rise of those sects is read of in the books of the Maccabees.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

points: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez is of Judah, so this is the lineage of Judah, how they came about right down to the king. Pharez begat Hezron, and Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon, and Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
The line runs from Perez through his sons Hezron and Hamul, and the sons of Zerah are named, five in all.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah

points: These verses name the children of Judah and Benjamin who dwelt in Jerusalem: from Judah, Athaiah of the line of Perez, and Maaseiah of the line of Shiloni; from Benjamin, Sallu and his brethren.

Four hundred threescore and eight valiant men of the sons of Perez dwelt in Jerusalem, and Joel and Judah were set as overseers over the city. These are a name register, the record of the families that repopulated the city.
